data.one_liner: Over-the-air translation delivery for Flutter apps using Crowdin CDN and ARB files.
data.what_it_does: Fetches translation updates dynamically from the Crowdin Content Delivery Network at runtime. Automatically falls back to local ARB files when cloud translations are unavailable.
use_when: You manage app translations in Crowdin and want to deliver updates without app store releases
You use standard Flutter ARB localization files
avoid_when: You do not use Crowdin for translation management
You prefer local-only translation files without remote over-the-air sync
strengths: Enables real-time translation updates and previews
Automatic fallback to local ARB files for offline or error states
weaknesses: Requires manual maintenance of ARB files alongside Crowdin
Complex setup for real-time preview including OAuth and deep linking configurations
data.setup_notes: Requires internationalized Flutter app setup, creating a Crowdin distribution hash, running the SDK generation command, and optionally configuring OAuth for real-time previews.

alternatives.name: easy_localization
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer managing local translation files directly in various formats without relying on a third-party translation platform CDN like Crowdin.

alternatives.name: slang
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a type-safe localization generation tool with rich dart-based translation files.
